verdict.rationale: An operating system's data-handling posture, including whether user data feeds AI training, is a fair axis for a desktop OS, so the story applies. The evidence pack has no documented control, opt-out or policy about AI-training use of user data. The only related item is a generic marketing claim that Ubuntu 'prioritizes user privacy', which is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
